These PNGs are synthetic, generated by `scripts/ocr/generate-fixtures.ps1` using
the text and rendering settings in `cases.json`. They contain no screen or
clipboard content. Font files are not included. The committed rasters make CI
independent of installed CJK fonts or Windows OCR language packs.

`scripts/ocr/smoke-onnx.ps1` runs the real FP32 detector, classifier and recognizer
on English, mixed Chinese/English, dark, transparent, rotated, empty and 1-pixel
images. It checks text (ignoring spacing differences between independent boxes)
and multiline output, then saves measured cold/warm timings to `target/ocr-smoke`.
